A.acceptance: Read using POSIX dirfd and O_NOFOLLOW, hash-check before schema parser; unsafe reads remain integrity quarantine, never release; new synthetic tests.

rivals: Path.resolve followed by Path.read_bytes is sufficient against path swaps
Descriptor-anchored read closes path-swap gap at audit moment
Attacker with writable trusted root remains outside scope
